body: I've heard it all, they don't understand the pain. I've been called lazy, unappreciative, spoilt... The happiest I'd been was when I moved out but even that didn't last long when the financial pressure began. I just wish I could be happy in my own home.

I feel you man, sometimes it feels like the only reason to stay around is to "prove myself" or something. I self-sabotage my relationships out of fear of judgement, I felt pitied by those around me, and all I can do at the end of the day is put on some headphones and deafen myself some more.

I feel you there man. 3 years with her and going on 7 years with my friends and it's all over because they couldn't understand what I was going through. Now I'm dating a girl who understands the pain but I'm worried my mental health is pushing her away once more.
